POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201

# A rejected identifier is reported in the detail and as a subproblem.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "Example.org"}]}
$code == 400
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains Example.org
$body.detail contains not lowercase
$body.subproblems[0].type == urn:ietf:params:acme:error:rejectedIdentifier
$body.subproblems[0].detail == DNS name is not lowercase
$body.subproblems[0].identifier == {"type":"dns","value":"Example.org"}
$body.subproblems[1] !exists

# Every rejected identifier gets a subproblem, and no order is created.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.org"}, {"type": "dns", "value": "foo_bar.example.org"}, {"type": "dns", "value": "www.example.org"}, {"type": "dns", "value": "example.org."}]}
$code == 400
error == rejectedIdentifier
$header.Location !exists
$body.detail contains foo_bar.example.org
$body.detail contains and 1 more
$body.subproblems[0].identifier.value == foo_bar.example.org
$body.subproblems[0].detail contains invalid character
$body.subproblems[1].identifier.value == example.org.
$body.subproblems[1].detail contains empty label
$body.subproblems[2] !exists

# P-Labels are valid Punycode that decodes to Normalization Form C. They
# don't have to be valid IDNA labels, like the last one, which decodes to an
# uppercase letter.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "xn--bcher-kva.example.org"}]}
$code == 201

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "www.xn--e1afmkfd.example.org"}]}
$code == 201

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "*.xn--mgbh0fb.example.org"}]}
$code == 201

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "xn--cole-pka.example.org"}]}
$code == 201

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "xn--bcher-kva9.example.org"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.subproblems[0].detail contains not valid Punycode

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "xn--ecole-6ed.example.org"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.subproblems[0].detail contains Normalization Form C
